Chapter 602: Chapter 32: Six Hundred Years Of Time (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 602: Chapter 32: Six Hundred Years of Time (Please Subscribe)

For the Martial Realm, Lin Yuan doesn’t regard it as merely a simple place for cultivation.

It is also the world where the future Martial Dao Cultivators, after establishing their Divine Kingdoms, will reside.

The Martial Dao Cultivators here refer to those who step into the Eighth Layer True God through the Martial Tao Cultivation Skill.

Compared to Martial Dao Cultivators, the Martial Realm is similar to the Ocean of Light or the Dark Abyss in relation to the gods.

“What a pity, this world’s suppression of lifespan is too harsh, making it nearly impossible to normally comprehend the essence of external world rules and then reach the Seventh Layer within a thousand years; it’s as difficult as ascending to the heavens…”

Lin Yuan thought silently to himself.

...

The Martial Path Evolutionary Path, after Lin Yuan localized it, emphasized the excavation of one’s own bloodline.

Although this might lead to rapid advancement in the early stages,

overlooking the understanding of external rules makes it very difficult to create an Inner World on one’s own.

Do the gods hold up their Divine Kingdoms because they don’t want to absorb them into their Inner Worlds?

It’s that they cannot absorb them; the Divine Kingdoms formed by the power of belief cannot be absolutely controlled like the Inner Worlds of Eighth Layer Evolvers from the Main World.

Of course, even with such suppression by the world’s rules, Lin Yuan still left behind in the Martial Tao Cultivation Skill a method to comprehend external world rules and thereby open up an Inner World without relying on faith.

Even if this method was never going to be usable by future Martial Dao Cultivators of this world, Lin Yuan still left it behind.

“However, the advantages of the bloodline cultivation path are quite clear; by leveraging the power of bloodlines, there are almost no bottlenecks in the early stages of cultivation…”

Lin Yuan pondered quietly in his heart.

Every time he traversed a new World, Lin Yuan would try to extract the essence of the world’s cultivation system and then attempt to integrate it into his own Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

“Also, the construction of this world’s divine realms is much more stable than the Inner Worlds of normal Eighth and Ninth Rank powerhouses…”

Lin Yuan closed his eyes, and within the Inner Worlds of his two Primordial Spirits, countless Divine Kingdoms of the gods were rapidly analyzed, especially the Divine Kingdoms of the Prime Gods, which were far more complex than those of Myriad Heavy Realm powerhouses of the Ninth Rank.

If Lin Yuan were not an exception, having opened up an Inner Universe with one hundred and twenty million Spatial Layers, he would dominate over a Ninth Layer Prime God.

As just a Myriad Heavy Realm, it is estimated that he would struggle to get the better of those Prime Gods.

Even if one could win, it would not be possible to kill them completely; as long as the Prime Gods hid inside their Divine Kingdoms, relying solely on the power of a Myriad Heavy Realm would most likely not be enough.

Lin Yuan could try to cut off the gods’ connection to human faith, but the effects would be too slow.

The Prime Gods have harvested human faith for countless years, accruing enough faith to let them linger on for hundreds of thousands or even millions of years.

“The structure of the Divine Kingdom…”

Lin Yuan carefully examined the details of the Divine Kingdoms of the twenty-four Prime Gods.

[Your Against-Heaven’s Understanding is exceptional, observing a vast number of special World constructions, continuing to elevate your understanding of the World itself…]

…

[Your Against-Heaven’s Understanding is exceptional, observing a vast number of special World constructions, continuing to elevate your understanding of the World itself…]

…

[Your Against-Heaven’s Understanding is exceptional, observing a vast number of special World constructions, continuing to elevate your understanding of the World itself…]

…

For a moment, a surge of comprehension flooded his mind, and Lin Yuan subconsciously adjusted the subtle structures of his Inner World.

“My Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter, aside from creating more Spatial Layers, also made delicate changes to the Inner World itself…”

Lin Yuan’s eyes sparkled. All along, he had hesitated and hadn’t systematically perfected the Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter.

Because the path that Lin Yuan traversed in the Ninth Stage of Martial Dao was completely unreplicable; could those Martial Path Evolvers in the Main World comprehend the Divine Lattice? And perceive the essence of rules contained within it?

Without Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding, even if the Divine Lattice were put right in front of them, they would still gain nothing.

The gods of this world, despite possessing Divine Lattices for an incredibly long time, did not perceive the rules corresponding to the Divine Lattices as directly as Lin Yuan did.

Besides,

The Divine Lattice is a special product of this world; the Main World doesn’t even have the concept of a Divine Lattice, so the Martial Path Evolvers couldn’t possibly follow the path Lin Yuan has taken.

Consequently, if it couldn’t be widely adapted, even if Lin Yuan forcibly opened up the Ninth Rank Chapter, it wouldn’t stand out in any way.

But now, by comprehending a large number of Divine Kingdoms of gods and Prime Gods, Lin Yuan keenly seized the key to opening up the Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter.

No matter for the Eighth Rank, Ninth Rank, or even Tenth and Tier 11, the Inner World is the foundation, the source of one’s strength.

The construction of the Inner World, after continuous refinement by many evolutionary scholars of human civilization in the Main World, has reached a limit.

It’s similar to the shackles of a several million li radius that are difficult to improve by even a hair’s breadth.

But the Divine Kingdoms of the gods of this world have shown Lin Yuan a completely different direction from the Inner World.

In this situation, Lin Yuan, leveraging his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, has comprehended aspects of the Divine Kingdoms and then integrated them into the Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter.

“If successful, the Inner World of Ninth Rank Evolvers in the Martial Dao will be more stable and more perfect than the Inner Worlds of other powerhouses of the same level, and it will also be easier to transform into an Inner Universe in the future.”

Lin Yuan’s spirits were uplifted.

Put simply, this is equivalent to giving every Ninth Rank Evolver a World Tree in the future.

The World Tree, being an Eleven-Star top-notch cosmic Rare Treasure, has the effect of stabilizing the Inner World, and the Inner World perfected by Lin Yuan’s Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter is not far behind in terms of stability.

The most critical aspect is that this stability originates from the Inner World itself, not from external forces, so it can make the final transformation of the Inner World slightly easier.

Of course, the World Tree not only stabilizes the Inner World but even so, Ninth Rank Evolvers compared to other powerhouses of the same level, also have an Innate advantage.
